title: Mixed-support cup product
statement:
Fix the Poincare geometric and coefficient data [sk-def-set]: distinct primes $p,\ell$, $q=p^a$ with $a\geq1$, $k_0=\mathbf F_q$, its fixed algebraic closure $k$, a finite extension $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$ inside $\overline{\mathbf Q}_\ell$ with valuation ring $\mathcal O_E$ and uniformizer $\varpi_E$, and $A=A_{E,n}=\mathcal O_E/\varpi_E^n$ with $n\geq1$. Let $X_0/k_0$ be smooth of pure dimension $d\geq0$, separated of finite type and geometrically connected. Put $X=X_0\times_{k_0}k$, $s=\operatorname{Spec}k$, and let $a_X:X\to s$ be the structure morphism. Properness and an ambient exceptional-adjoint datum are not required.

For $\Lambda\in\{A,\mathcal O_E,E,\overline{\mathbf Q}_\ell\}$ and $K,L\in D^b_{ctf}(X,\Lambda)$ [def-weil-finite-tor-amplitude], use the six operations and coefficient cohomology of [sk-def-ops] on the small pro-etale sites [def-weil-pbc-proetale-site], the derived pullback and tensor of [def-weil-derived-pullback-tensor-hom], and the counit $\varepsilon_L:La_X^*Ra_{X*}L\to L$ of $La_X^*\dashv Ra_{X*}$ [fix-prop-adjunctions] (1). The finite-stage preservation statements [thm-sf-ctf-stability] (i)–(iv), the integral output-constructibility statements [lem-sf-integral-direct-image-constructible, lem-sf-integral-compact-support-constructible], and the higher-stage finite-Tor conventions [thm-sf-ctf-stability] (vii) ensure in particular that $Ra_{X*}L$ and $Ra_{X!}K$ lie in $D^b_{ctf}(s,\Lambda)$ and that $La_X^*Ra_{X*}L$ and $K\otimes^L_{\Lambda_X}La_X^*Ra_{X*}L$ lie in $D^b_{ctf}(X,\Lambda)$.

The *mixed-support cup product* is the morphism
$$
\smile_c^\Lambda=\mu^\Lambda_{K,L}:R\Gamma_c(X,K)\otimes^L_\Lambda R\Gamma(X,L)
\longrightarrow R\Gamma_c(X,K\otimes^L_{\Lambda_X}L)
$$
obtained by applying the point functor $\operatorname{Fib}_s$ [def-weil-finite-coefficient-point] to the composite
$$
\begin{aligned}
Ra_{X!}K\otimes^L_{\Lambda_s}Ra_{X*}L
&\xrightarrow{\operatorname{PF}_{a_X,K,Ra_{X*}L}}
Ra_{X!}\bigl(K\otimes^L_{\Lambda_X}La_X^*Ra_{X*}L\bigr)\\
&\xrightarrow{Ra_{X!}(1_K\otimes\varepsilon_L)}
Ra_{X!}\bigl(K\otimes^L_{\Lambda_X}L\bigr),
\end{aligned}
$$
using the canonical tensor identification of [lem-sf-point-fibre-derived-tensor]. Here $\operatorname{PF}$ is exactly the projection transformation of [sk-def-sf-exchanges], with second input $Ra_{X*}L$, not $L$. In this notation $R\Gamma_c(X,M)=\operatorname{Fib}_s(Ra_{X!}M)$ and $R\Gamma(X,M)=\operatorname{Fib}_s(Ra_{X*}M)$ as in [sk-def-ops]. This is the cup-product clause of [sk-def-pairing-data].

At $\mathcal O_E$ the operations and the composite use the derived-complete constructions, with finite reductions at every $A_{E,n}$; at $E$ the composite is rationalized from integral representatives; and at $\overline{\mathbf Q}_\ell$ it is the morphism class represented over a common finite coefficient field, with the transport conventions of [def-weil-derived-pullback-tensor-hom] and [sk-def-sf-exchanges]. These are adic pro-etale operations, rather than discrete non-torsion coefficients on the small etale site.

For the support-order convention in the source's phrase graded-commutative, also define the right-support product by
$$
\mu^{\Lambda,r}_{L,K}
=R\Gamma_c(X,\sigma_{K,L})\circ\mu^\Lambda_{K,L}\circ
\sigma_{R\Gamma(X,L),R\Gamma_c(X,K)},
$$
where $\sigma$ is the cochain symmetry $x\otimes y\mapsto(-1)^{ij}y\otimes x$ in bidegree $(i,j)$. Its type is
$$
R\Gamma(X,L)\otimes^L_\Lambda R\Gamma_c(X,K)
\longrightarrow R\Gamma_c(X,L\otimes^L_{\Lambda_X}K).
$$
Thus exchanging the factors exchanges the compact-support position; no identification $R\Gamma_c(X,-)=R\Gamma(X,-)$ is part of this definition.

The remaining assertions in the source's final sentence are properties of this constructed map: associativity and the unit law are recorded in [prop-pod-cup-product-coherence]; finite-reduction and coefficient-change compatibility are recorded in [prop-sf-mixed-cup-coefficient-change]. These are forward property references, not prerequisites for this definition.

blueprint_update.statement:
In the Poincare duality conventions of this chapter (the fixed setting), let $K,L\in D^b_{ctf}(X,A)$. The *mixed-support cup product* is the canonical map

$$
\smile _c:\  R\Gamma _c(X,K)\otimes _A^LR\Gamma (X,L) \longrightarrow R\Gamma _c\bigl(X,K\otimes ^L_{A_X}L\bigr)
$$

obtained as the composite of the projection transformation for $Rf_!$, applied to the pair $K,\; L'=Ra_{X*}L\in D^b_{ctf}(s,A)$,

$$
Ra_{X!}K\otimes _A^LRa_{X*}L \longrightarrow Ra_{X!}\bigl(K\otimes ^L_{A_X}La_X^*Ra_{X*}L\bigr),
$$

and the map induced by the counit $La_X^*Ra_{X*}L\to L$. The same construction at the $\mathcal O_E$-, $E$-, and $\overline{\mathbf Q}_{\ell }$-stages is obtained by levelwise application and transport.

The cup product is associative and unital, graded-commutative, and
compatible with finite reduction and base change of the coefficient ring.
